name: Rydöbruk - Kvarnforsen
description: Rydöbruk to Kvarnforsen. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official page/API says 10 km/10000 m; GPX desc is Total: 10.3 km and computed geometry 10.248 km; Naturkartan displays 10.4 km; Woods/Hylte page title says 11 km.

Current official GPX/API/Naturkartan starts at Rydöbruk 56.957390,13.142808 and ends at Kvarnforsen 56.894596,13.188851. API line.geometry and OSM relation preserve old Sandsjön-Kvarnforsen-Gyltige linework starting at Sandsjön and continuing beyond Kvarnforsen.
M6 same-track next card points to Ästad - Vessigebro on Mellersta delleden, which is not geographically continuous. Physical onward route from Kvarnforsen is Kvarnforsen - Gyltige on Södra delleden.
M5 sources include Lahult/Sandsjön/Kvarnforsen records/images, but M6 prose/API clearly assign them to M6.
Section prose says shelters can accommodate 4-6 adults, while Sandsjön place/Woods text says 4-5 people.
Hallandsleden drinking-water category returns zero for M6. Naturkartan says nearby landowner can provide drinking water/firewood/shower.
